reveal_lines: The Crawling Chaos remembers.
Turn 1, as you arrived on a level: whisper 1 (ambient) was admitted.
Telegraph: "A distant whisper brushes against your thoughts."
Effect: an omen only; no rule changed.
Delivered: yes, "The shadows lean closer." was shown with the telegraph.
Spent at once.
Turn 24, after you doubled back: a haunting was admitted.
Telegraph: "Something has learned the rhythm of your footsteps."
Effect: an echo hound was set to follow your trail.
Delivered: yes, you saw it follow your trail 5 times.
Ended: its hunt ended on turn 84.
Motif: the whistle, 2 programs, felt 1 time.
Turn 398: next-use program 1 was admitted.
Origin: you whistled on DL2 on turn 185.
Rebound: first written about an earlier one (turn 46).
Telegraph: "For a while, your whistles may carry farther than they should."
Effect: for a while, any whistle could answer it, at most 2 times.
Delivered: no; no manifestation reached you.
Ended: its uses ran out or it expired before the game ended.
Turn 1180: next-use program 2 was admitted.
Origin: you whistled on DL4 on turn 1152.
Rebound: first written about an earlier one (turn 1079).
Telegraph: "For a while, your whistles may carry farther than they should."
Effect: for a while, any whistle could answer it, at most 2 times.
Delivered: yes, 1 time; you saw your companion answer the whistle.
Ended: its uses ran out or it expired before the game ended.
Turn 986, as you prayed: whisper 2 (door_reluctance) was admitted.
Telegraph: "The doors of this place seem to lean against you."
Effect: closed doors resisted you more often, for 62 turns.
Delivered: no; a rule change has no separate manifestation.
Ended: expired on turn 1048.
Turn 1505, as your Sanity crossed a threshold: whisper 3 (door_reluctance) was admitted.
Telegraph: "The doors of this place seem to lean against you."
Effect: closed doors resisted you more often, for 72 turns.
Delivered: no; a rule change has no separate manifestation.
Ended: expired on turn 1577.
Admitted 6, delivered 3; cruelty spent 6.
1 other candidate was refused; none took effect.
